integrity: The source mixture and response are attributed to the primary literature. The proof and exact-rational checker are self-contained. No independent audit or historical-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact global phase diagram concerns unconditional group-level adoption under the specified two-binomial composition mixture and deterministic integer-count threshold. It is not an epidemic threshold theorem. For finite sigmoid steepness, only persistence of a local extremum sufficiently near the hard-threshold extremum is proved.
title: Exact one-turn phase diagram for homophily and threshold group adoption
